additional_info.body:

Thanks for your email.
Kindly be informed that ordering ES is required in case we are not able to commission the DC EVC, while the case which we are facing is different. The case here is a faulty HMI based on site troubleshooting.
We can proceed with ordering ES just in case we are not able to commission the unit or troubleshoot the fault of the HMI.
So, your confirmation of a faulty HMI is required to claim the new HMI accordingly.
BR,
Sadek
